title: LessonDuplications admin list could use depth=1 in the list query for richer data
body: The custom Cell components now safely display IDs when relationships aren't populated, but a better fix would be to configure the admin list to use depth=1 so relationships are always populated. This would require a custom list component that passes depth=1 to the find query.
rationale: The Cell fix is a fallback display improvement; depth=1 in the list query would be a more complete solution.
